d: We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer to design, develop, customize, integrate, and support ERP solutions across Finance, Supply Chain, Inventory, Warehouse Management, Procurement, Order Management, Marketplace Operations, and related business systems.
q: 4+ years of ERP development experience, with at least 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations technical development experience.
Strong knowledge of X++, Visual Studio, extensions, event handlers, Chain of Command, Data Entities, OData, and DMF.
Experience in REST APIs, enterprise integration patterns, performance tuning, and SQL-based data validation.
Solid understanding of ERP processes across Finance, Supply Chain, Inventory, WMS, Procurement, and Sales.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
Experience with AWS-hosted services, message queues (RabbitMQ, Redis), and monitoring tools (Datadog, CloudWatch).
Experience in retail, e-commerce, marketplace, grocery, logistics, or high-volume warehouse operations.
